name: nim-http-api
title: Nim HTTP API
blurb: Nim 1.6+ JSON service: a pure counting core, a pure router, asynchttpserver on top, and a unittest suite behind nimble build/test
default_description: A Nim JSON service that counts lines, words and bytes.

verify.name: http
verify.cmd: if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5415/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'port 5415 is already answering - stop that process before running this step'; exit 1; fi; PORT=5415 ./{{ package_name }} >.nim.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ready=1; for _ in $(seq 1 120); do if curl --max-time 2 -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5415/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; kill -0 $srv 2>/dev/null || { echo 'the server exited before it answered'; exit 1; }; if [ $ready -ne 0 ]; then cat .nim.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; health=$(curl --max-time 10 -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5415/health); stats=$(curl --max-time 10 -s 'http://127.0.0.1:5415/stats?text=hello%20world%0A'); posted=$(curl --max-time 10 -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"text":"a b\nc\n"}' http://127.0.0.1:5415/stats); bad=$(curl --max-time 10 -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5415/stats); missing=$(curl --max-time 10 -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:5415/nope); kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null || true; cat .nim.log; test "$health" = 200 && printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"lines":1' && printf '%s' "$stats" | grep -q '"bytes":12' && printf '%s' "$posted" | grep -q '"words":3' && test "$bad" = 422 && test "$missing" = 404
